ITEM PARAGRAPHS
Researchers
need
to
understand
why
different
forms
of
locomotion
evolved
.
Long-held
assumptions
,
such
as
the
need
for
energy
efficiency
,
have
already
been
overturned
.
For
example
,
a
mechanical
ankle
brace
can
improve
the
metabolic
efficiency
of
human
walking
,
implying
that
walking
is
inefficient
.
But
variation
of
movement
is
important
,
too
:
such
an
ankle
brace
holds
you
back
if
you
try
to
skip
,
gallop
or
skitter
.
Similarly
,
legged
robots
struggle
to
deploy
different
gaits
,
just
as
roboticists
struggle
to
enumerate
them
.
